config.design: Frozen H984 small6 baselines; fresh expanded six-family and seven-family fits. Same128 atoms/32groups, initial parameters, Adam learning rate and600steps. Full-batch fits expose more states per step; not matched FLOPs. Equal-family reconstruction and normalized pair-change means avoid family-count weighting changes. No validation selection.
config.limits: Country-language excluded atMLP12. New context panel plus old whole-task holdouts reused for all models. Changes include training distribution, train-derived scaling and sample count, not a pure sample-size randomized experiment. No causal model forwards.
